p.PACKAGE-BOUNDARY: lang:org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang is the Lean checker/carrier projection of flow:org.vibevm.ai-native/core-ai-native. The family version is 0.1.0; this is separate from Lean 4.34.1 and all carrier/result schema versions. Code belongs at the package root and prompt/spec content under vibevm/vibespecs. Build and proof output are outside the shippable source identity.

p.MODEL-GRADE: The initial runner issues only G1 model-proof evidence. G0 is a declared trace link; G1 adds successful checking of the exact selected model theorem under recorded assumptions. G2 implementation conformance, G3 implementation refinement and G4 system refinement are not issued. A theorem about a model does not prove any unbound Rust/TypeScript code or product correct.

p.RUNNER-SCAN: scan --carrier validates sidecar declarations and exact referenced spec units through the shared core Markdown/XML parsers, then returns inventory with schema lean-ai-native/theorem-inventory/1, status declared and claims. Scan does not run the Lean proof checker or establish theorem existence. Its verifies relationships are declared trace inventory, never a proof witness.

p.RUNNER-CHECK: check --carrier --subject selects an exact fully qualified spec subject, verifies its declared spec revision/content binding, snapshots the explicit local Lean sources in dependency-first order, invokes the pinned real Lean checker, resolves the named theorem from the checked environment, and audits its proposition and actual axiom dependencies. Only successful checking with permitted assumptions may produce a G1 witness. A comment or similar spelling is not a theorem.

p.RUNNER-VERIFY-WITNESS: verify-witness --carrier --subject --witness reads a ProofWitness object directly, binds the exact requested subject, validates current carrier/spec/source/dependency/toolchain identity and freshly checks the theorem. Successful Reply.result is {status: "matched", witness: ...}. Parsed JSON, self-reported success and old compiled output cannot replace the fresh run. Wrong or stale identities fail.

p.TOOLCHAIN: The required toolchain identifier is leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1. Select its externally installed distribution with --toolchain-dir or LEAN_AI_NATIVE_TOOLCHAIN_DIR. The runner checks the pinned version and fingerprints its bin/lib distribution boundary. It does not install/download tools. Imports initially use only explicit local sources plus that distribution; arbitrary Lake dependency scripts are unsupported. Project Lean source is trusted code and the elaborator is not a sandbox.

p.SOURCE-CLOSURE: The carrier explicitly lists every local Lean source required for the selected model in dependency-first build order. The runner snapshots those local sources and binds their content with the exact spec unit, carrier and pinned distribution identity. Omitted or unsupported imports cannot be silently loaded as unrecorded dependencies. A filename, package version or old compiled module is not a replacement for this source boundary.

p.AXIOMS: allowed_axioms is an explicit subset of propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice. Record actual theorem axiom dependencies and require them to be contained in that set. Custom axioms, proof holes/sorry axioms and native proof-evaluation axioms are refused even if a caller tries to allow them. Permission for the fixed logical assumptions is visible in the witness and does not prove their empirical applicability.

p.WITNESS: Only actual successful checking may return a g1_model ProofWitness. It binds exact subject and authored spec revision/content, named theorem/checked proposition, carrier/local source identities, checker/pinned distribution identity and permitted/observed assumptions. CLI responses are Reply{ok,result?,error?}; for successful check, result itself is the ProofWitness. Require ok == true before saving result for later verification. The witness is evidence, not authority; verify-witness freshly rechecks it.

p.FAIL-CLOSED: No success witness is produced for malformed carrier, missing theorem, failed checker, unexpected axiom, wrong subject, stale source or unsupported grade/toolchain/dependency path. Failure remains distinguishable from a successful theorem whose assumptions have limited scope.

p.NEGATIVE-CASES: Acceptance of the runner requires focused cases for missing theorem, checker failure, unexpected axiom, malformed carrier, stale/wrong-subject witness and reproducible successful checking. These are required cases, not a claim that the documentation executed them.

p.PARITY: The projection follows spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/core-ai-native/00-MANIFESTO#PARITY-ACROSS-PROJECTIONS. Missing full-floor/conform/scaffold/codemod and cross-language refinement mechanisms are recorded as WISH or unsupported with their reasons in the guide. No complete discipline-floor claim follows from the targeted proof runner.
